  • 詳細探討遊戲追求「極致擬真」所帶來的雙面刃效應，包含冗長的生活瑣事與拖沓的開局節奏。
  • 全面解析引發社群廣泛爭議的全新機制，如 30 幀率效能限制、道德犯罪系統以及繁瑣的偷車流程。

摘要

銷量奇蹟與媒體盛讚背後的質疑聲浪

作者指出，歷經長達十三年的漫長等待，《GTA 6》正式推出即創下首日高達 37.9 億美元的驚人銷售紀錄。然而，各大媒體在 Metacritic 平台給予 99 分的歷史級超高評價，並紛紛給出滿分盛讚的同時，卻在社群中引發了信任危機。許多玩家與內容創作者質疑，部分媒體評測明列了主線節奏緩慢、缺乏任務重玩功能等缺陷卻依然給予滿分，背後恐是擔憂遭到發行商 Rockstar 列入黑名單而喪失未來合作與搶先體驗權益。

極致擬真與繁瑣瑣事帶來的體驗爭議

在遊戲表現上，Rockstar 打造的世界在細節、光影與 NPC 互動上都達到了令人屏息的真實度，但這份真實卻伴隨著沉重的妥協。除了在次世代主機上僅能維持 30 幀的畫面表現引發討論外，遊戲開局的慢節奏更是社群爭議的焦點。玩家發現自己無法立即享受街頭破壞的快感，反而需要耗費大量時間打掃房屋、採買雜貨與經營人際關係，被譏諷為變成了「模擬市民」；儘管知名實況主 Kai Cenat 等人強調只要度過第一章的門檻後體驗便會漸入佳境，但前期的繁瑣雜事無疑磨損了許多玩家的耐心。

自由受限：犯罪檔案系統與嚴苛偷車限制

除了節奏問題，本作全新導入的犯罪檔案系統更被指責違背了系列精髓。作者說明，該系統會監控玩家的暴力行為，若隨意殺害路人或警察將會累積犯罪嚴重度，甚至直接鎖定為壞結局，讓許多習慣在遊戲中釋放破壞慾望的玩家感到被強迫當「好人」。與此同時，過去招牌的偷車機制也大幅增加了複雜度，玩家不再能隨意開門揚長而去，而是需要工具解鎖、防盜訊號複製器，並面對警報器與追蹤器的干擾，這些過於貼近現實的設計讓部分玩家感到自由度嚴重受限且備受挫折。

================================================

After waiting 13 years for GTA 6, players can finally take time off from work to flock to Miami for vacation. The good news: GTA 6 is incredibly realistic . The bad news: GTA 6 is actually too realistic. >> I’m definitely going to rob banks, play the thief, and wreak total havoc in there. >> Ha, hello everyone, welcome to Player Confidential. As the most anticipated title in the gaming world, GTA 6 had already. accumulated massive attention even before its official launch. Media outlets that experienced the game early released their reviews one after another , practically placing this masterpiece on a pedestal. According to official data, GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies before release, with first-day retail sales hitting $ 3.79 billion, shattering all entertainment industry launch records. Now that the game has been out for a while, many players have started sharing their experiences online, but some overseas media actually wrote articles mocking players for their complaints. Furthermore, these two titles, hailed as the strongest current. and all-time games, were actually review-bombed by some extreme players on Metacritic. What on earth happened? Next , Player Confidential will share the controversy between the media and player ratings for GTA 6. If there’s anything we missed or anything you’d like to add , feel free to leave a comment below. Before the video begins, remember to like and subscribe to our channel, and don't forget to hit the notification bell so you don't miss our updates. In fact, GTA 6 has been full of buzz and controversy both before and after its release. Player Confidential recently made a. video about these events, so feel free to go watch it if you're interested. As various media outlets released their GTA 6 scores, almost all of them praised the game to the skies. Metacritic collected scores from 152 outlets, resulting in a staggering 99, making it the highest-rated game on Metacritic alongside the original Ocarina of Time. Many outlets even gave GTA 6 a perfect score, universally praising the open world and noting that Rockstar created a setting that is incredibly detailed, vibrant, and immersive. Media were also quite satisfied with the character. development of Jason and Lucia, their relationship, and the overall plot, believing the chemistry between them makes the story even more compelling. However, this one-sided praise soon sparked skepticism among some players, as they noticed the media claimed the game wasn't perfect, yet still gave it a perfect score. Furthermore, major outlets like IGN, FCE , and GameSpot noted several shortcomings, including the lack of a mission replay feature, a slow-paced main story, and a redundant crime rating system, yet they still awarded it a.

perfect score. This led content creators to criticize these outlets, arguing that listing flaws while giving a perfect score defies logic. They suspect reviewers gave high marks out of fear of Rockstar, worried that negative reviews might cost them early access, interviews, or future collaborations. Interestingly, a game journalist came forward, revealing that they were blacklisted by Rockstar back in 2013 for failing to give GTA V a glowing review. With GTA 6 officially released, many. players began sharing their experiences online, with many agreeing that the world Rockstar built this time is simply breathtaking. The game doesn't just improve graphics; the level of detail in environments, NPC reactions, environmental interactions, and dynamic street events makes the world feel truly alive, so real that players can even see themselves. It's as if a parody video from less than a year ago actually came true, with only the main character missing. The game's visual performance. Character animations, lighting effects, sound design, and the driving experience have all convinced many players that Rockstar has once again proven its prowess in open-world games. However, despite the game's many amazing features, there is still plenty of dissatisfaction online. The most common complaint, echoing since before launch, is that a title players waited 13 years for can only run at 30. frames per second on PS5 and PS5 Pro. Even the YouTube channel Digital Foundry , known for technical analysis, noted that while the game holds a solid 30 fps on PS5 Pro, it occasionally dips into the 20s on the standard PS5. 30. >> But some players and streamers argue that the frame rate isn't a major issue , as long as they can enjoy the game. Beyond frame rates, some players have also reported encountering various strange bugs during their playthrough. Yet, compared to frame rates and bugs— issues raised since day one—players are more focused on the game's core content and mechanics, especially the early-game pacing, which has left quite a few players feeling impatient. Everyone expected to jump straight into crime and chaos in GTA 6, but the game starts off by making players spend a lot of time cleaning, fixing up houses, buying groceries, and even accompanying Lucia on various daily activities to slowly build their relationship. I thought playing games was meant to be an escape.

from reality, but it turns out I just switched to a different world to keep living a life just like the real one, only with hyper-realistic graphics. This has led some players, who spent hours without seeing the content they expected, to complain, "I used to play to escape reality and be an outlaw; now I'm playing GTA to learn how to be a professional errand boy. This isn't GTA, it's The Sims." "Got haircut, picked up flowers, got grocery sho..." >> Even the founder, Zaber, joined in on. the meme. Seeing his wife ask him to go buy groceries, he couldn't help but joke , "Wait, which version did I get?" Even Elon Mask found it hilarious in the comments. Others brought up past quotes from CliffyB, stating that he never believed games are better the closer they get to reality because gaming is meant for fun, indirectly mocking some unnecessary elements in GTA 6. "Why that's interesting? Because in the real world, I have to write up lists of stuff I have to go to the grocery store to buy . And I've never thought to myself that realism is fun. I go play games to have fun." Although these mundane tasks are technically optional, for players wanting to improve the relationship between Jason and Lucia or unlock better story outcomes, it seems hard to ignore them completely. However, some players argue that this slow pace isn't a big problem; after all, Rockstar's Red Dead Redemption 2 also spent a significant amount of time on story buildup at the start, and once you get through Chapter One, the experience gets better and better. Famous streamer Kai Cenat also mentioned that while he thinks GTA 6 isn't as funny, lighthearted, or fun as GTA 5, the game's realism is truly breathtaking. He also mentioned that there's a hurdle in the early game that. can make you lose motivation, but once you clear the first chapter, you just can't stop playing, and he gave the game an 8.8 out of 10. "In the beginning, I remember I was in the beginning. If you don't get past a certain hump, you could start to feel demotivated. But once you get past that hump, chapter one is OD. Listen to me. There's no way. You cannot tell me there's nobody out there who gets past chapter one and be like, ' No, I don't want to. This game is ass.' There's no way in hell you get past chapter one and say, 'I want to stop playing this. There's just no way.' If I. had to rate this game out of 10, honestly, I would rate this game 8.8." >> Another feature sparking a lot of discussion among players is the new crime file system in GTA 6. Simply put, this system judges whether Jason and Lucia are professional criminals or total psychopaths based on their habitual criminal behavior. If players avoid unnecessary killing and use non-lethal methods to subdue enemies , they can maintain a lower crime level . Conversely, if players frequently kill pedestrians, police, or even helpless.

targets, the crime level will gradually become more violent. Once the maximum crime level is reached, the game deems the character beyond redemption and locks in the bad ending. Although some players feel that this consequence-based mechanic enhances immersion, many worry that they must restrain their criminal behavior to experience a better story outcome. For some, it feels like the game is forcing them to be "good guys." For a franchise like GTA, which has always sold itself on the freedom to commit crimes and cause chaos, players feel this mechanic might have worked for Red Dead Redemption 2, but it’s just. frustrating in GTA, leading to widespread complaints. So this game called GTA 6 actually punishes you for playing it like a GTA game. Rockstar built a complete moral system for players who are already beyond saving within ten minutes of starting the game. Even the official Domino's UK account mocked the terrible system, and some players have been labeled as violent criminals for doing nothing wrong, simply because an NPC crashed into their car. Therefore,. Of course, it’s not just the crime system that’s causing dissatisfaction among some players; the changes to the car theft mechanics have also sparked significant discussion. In past GTA titles, players could basically just walk up to a car, open the door, and drive away. But this time , Rockstar added more complex anti-theft mechanisms, leaving many players frustrated. GTA. literally open, literally open. Let me in the car. >> In fact, in this generation, some cars require tools to unlock, and high-end vehicles even require a key fob cloner. Essentially, Rockstar wants car theft to have more layers, giving the process progression and options. However, compared to the past where you could just hop in and go, these new restrictions are naturally more troublesome for some players. Not to mention, some cars are equipped. with alarms and trackers, making theft more challenging—one player even stole a Tesla and ended up being trapped inside . >> Damn, I can't get out. [ __ ], are electric cars this terrifying ? Electric cars?

Oh, [ __ ]. Screw this, man. I'm never stealing a Tesla again. >> Before I get in, the car belongs to me; once I'm in, I belong to the car. Congrats on unlocking the hidden achievement "Self-Driving Car." But compared to cars, I still think stealing...No. Hey, hey, that's. go, my god. >> Some players feel GTA6 isn't as stellar as previous entries, with lackluster character development that makes it hard to leave a lasting impression. I love it, bro. The game is man. It's like exactly what I wanted from a GTA story. >> For me is me. I give like a seven for now, bro. >> F >> The female lead, Lucia, has drawn. criticism for her overbearing personality. She always insists on her own way, often dumping tasks onto Jason, which can lead to friction. She’s always chasing big scores without a solid plan, leaving Jason to clean up her mess. >> She's impulsive. She's stupid. She's jealous. She um you know doesn't understand her place in a relationship. She isn't skilled. She's selfish. She uh you know is emotionally manipulative not telling him that he had. a husband. So basically there is no real redeeming quality about Lucia. >> Even female streamers, upon seeing the relationship between Jason and Lucia deteriorate, couldn't help but find Lucia annoying, joking that being a man is just too tough. Some started mocking the idea that Jason might have lived a carefree, worry-free life until Lucia and her child showed up, suddenly piling on emotional, domestic, and financial troubles, as if a burden was forced into his otherwise good life. They joke that for the protagonist, it truly validates the saying, "I wanted to find someone to weather the storm with, only to realize. the storm was brought by my partner."" You can say whatever you want about this guy, but at least you won't see him abandoning a baby in a coffee shop." This is definitely a fault of the development team! Change the model, use this look and it'll be fine...Wait, no, this would cause even more outrage. >> As for the male lead, Jason, Rockstar originally seemed to want a grounded, believable character through his stoic personality. To their surprise, many streamers find Jason boring and impossible to resonate with, with some even preferring to play as Lucia.

I think Jason as a main character for me is really boring. I think he's a boring character. I think he has the personality of a rock . Every time he talks >> Some players also complain that he doesn't talk much because Rockstar's female writers don't know how to write male characters. We expected Trevor 2.0 , but got a "simp" instead. Furthermore , some players are unsatisfied with Jason's voice acting. Some have even used past titles to parody Jason. Ok. See you later. >> AI-generated videos have past GTA. characters appearing to mock Jason and Lucia. E. Take you so long. Come on it. However, most of these issues aren't even problems for the PC version. After all, once the PC version drops and all sorts of mods appear, players will have the chance to transform the game into exactly what they want to play. Some creators have even started compiling lists of mods players want based on current info, so they'll know what to build if GTA 6 gets a PC release —assuming it actually does, of course. When players started criticizing certain aspects of GTA 6, the media jumped in to attack them before the game’s actual.

die-hard fans even had a chance to react . Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier mocked players who criticized the " buying groceries and flowers for your girlfriend" missions, labeling them as nothing more than a bunch of incels. Bro , no wonder you're named Jason too. Why don't you clock out already? >> To avoid getting shredded by the player base, reporter Jason locked his replies so only select accounts could respond. Naturally, players started quote-tweeting him to dig up his past controversies. As for what he’s done in the past, I’ve made a video about it before, so interested viewers can check that out. It wasn't just Jason; many overseas. media outlets jumped to defend the game . Kotaku shifted the focus to the "male loneliness epidemic," claiming figures like Andrew Tate and Sneako promote toxic views to young men. They then brought it back to GTA 6, arguing that Jason's tasks—like sending flowers, giving gifts, doing chores, and spending time with Lucia—aren't just missions, but opportunities for players to rethink relationships and how to be a better partner. They even suggested GTA 6 might unexpectedly become a remedy for male. loneliness. Honest question: so if I send flowers and gifts in a game, I have a shot at getting a real-life girlfriend ? >> Impossible. Absolutely impossible. Beyond Kotaku, other outlets went even harder on players. Rolling Stone mocked the idea that players feel their "masculinity" is threatened just by being nice to a virtual girlfriend. Wired claimed that players viewing chores as a loss of dignity only exposes their obsession with traditional male archetypes. IGN criticized male players from another. angle, arguing they’re fine objectifying Lucia as a sexual fantasy, but can't handle a game that asks them to respect a female character. These articles quickly sparked a new wave of backlash. Creators argued that these outlets are trivializing valid player criticisms of quest design, pacing, and story by framing it as "men refusing to learn how to be a good boyfriend"—as if disliking menial chores in a game somehow implies hostility toward women. This has led many players to mock these media outlets, saying the article was " written by those 'sweet babies' you're forced to respect in games and self-righteous women; so I'm an incel just because I want GTA to stay GTA, not turn into some HR simulator." Similarly, on Metacritic, while GTA 6 received stellar reviews from critics, nobody expected the result once the user score opened. No...wait...there's more. Players pointed out that Metacritic's user scores aren't exactly reliable, since.

the platform doesn't require users to prove they've purchased or played the game. In other words, even if you’ve never played GTA 6, you could theoretically go and rate it yourself. Therefore, many players believe that compared to sites like Metacritic which are prone to review bombing, PlayStation Store ratings might better reflect real players 'feelings, especially since GTA 6 once held a rating of over 4.8 on the PS Store, a stark contrast to the Metacritic user score. But even so, some argue that high scores on PS don't necessarily mean the game is actually that good, as the recent Marvel's. Spider-Man 2 also received plenty of criticism yet still maintained a high score on PS; it seems we'll have to wait for Steam to see what players really think. It's worth noting that because Metacritic doesn't require proof of purchase, many suspect GTA 6 was review-bombed from the start, with these negative reviews not only criticizing the game for being "woke," but some even admitting they hadn't played it, or just posting nonsense. Unexpectedly, even The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time from 1998 and 2006 got dragged into this, as some extreme GTA 6 fans began retaliating by review-bombing Ocarina of. Time, leading extreme fans on both sides to spam negative reviews on each other's favorite games while giving their own titles perfect scores. That said, some players analyzed the data and found that this community infighting isn't actually as severe as one might imagine. According to the statistics, over 80%of the accounts that left negative reviews for GTA 6 did not leave a rating for Ocarina of Time. In other words, aside from players who actually played the game and were dissatisfied with the content, many of these negative reviews may just be from people jumping on the bandwagon. As time went on, the Metacritic user score gradually climbed. from 3.7 to 5.7. Although many players find GTA6 to be good and praise it as fun, some of its mechanics and settings have sparked quite a bit of debate. The reason this game has caused such a phenomenon in the community is, in some respects, precisely because it is called GTA. Perhaps Take-Two wants to continue leveraging the value of the GTA brand, but this iteration differs from past titles in the series. It features incredibly detailed, realistic design similar to Red Dead Redemption 2, but it lacks the freedom of previous GTA games . This has led some players to dislike. this restricted gameplay experience, while others accept or even enjoy this more realistic feel. If Take-Two had developed a brand-new IP today, perhaps there wouldn't be so much controversy. But the question is, without the GTA brand, would it be able to attract so many players? That is likely a completely different story. What are your thoughts on the controversy surrounding the media and player ratings for GTA6? What score would you give GTA6 ? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, and join our Patreon for some fantastic adult-oriented games !

發售前的爭議與遊戲反響

作者介紹，萬代南夢宮旗下加拿大工作室 Reflector Entertainment 開發的《無名九使：覺醒》，在上市前便因女主角造型與真人臉模差異、以及 Sweet Baby 聯合創始人參與製作等消息引發爭論。Reflector 對 DEI 的重視，以及工作室在 Steam 討論區處理批評言論的方式，也進一步加深了社群反彈。

跨媒體企圖與工作室收縮

Reflector 原本計畫以《無名九使》打造涵蓋小說、漫畫和影集的跨媒體宇宙。影片指出，萬代南夢宮收購並支持 Reflector，是希望藉此拓展歐美市場；然而，遊戲的市場表現未能支撐原先的雄心。

上市約一個月後，Reflector 展開首波裁員，約有 18% 員工受影響。其後新任執行長將《無名九使：覺醒》形容為失敗，並取消後續企畫、進行第二波裁員，顯示工作室的營運與開發方向已大幅收縮。

工作室關閉與投資損失

作者表示，萬代南夢宮於 2026 年 11 月宣布解散並清算 Reflector，預計認列約2,100 萬歐元的特別損失。影片將這項決定視為萬代不再繼續投入資金的結果，也以此呈現單一作品失利對開發團隊造成的重大影響。

摘要

上市熱潮與評價爭議

作者指出，等待多年的《GTA 6》掀起全球熱潮，但作品也在推出前後引發不少爭議。遊戲尚未正式發售便入圍 TGA 多項獎項，令部分玩家認為媒體炒作過度、其他作品因此失去曝光；投票過程出現異常，也讓社群質疑評選機制。媒體給予遊戲極高分數，卻被玩家批評忽視掉幀等問題，甚至有人指控 R 星可能影響媒體評價。

直播限制、效能與 Bug

作者接著提到，中國直播平台對遊戲中的暴力情節設下嚴格限制，讓實況主的遊玩方式受到約束。主機版本鎖定30 FPS，也引發玩家對效能表現的不滿。遊戲畫面流傳出飛機撞上建築卻沒有損傷等片段，雖有些情況能以設定選項解釋，仍不乏墜機不死、穿模與掉出地圖等 Bug，成為玩家調侃的素材。

相較於系列過往的犯罪冒險風格，作者表示本作更著重 Jason 與 Lucia 的感情發展，加入討好伴侶、買花等日常互動，也移除了部分傳統玩法。部分玩家認為 Jason 顯得缺乏主見，感情互動回饋有限，令節奏拖沓；相關批評又延伸成對女性編劇及政治正確的爭論。此外，夜店不能拔槍、部分示威者不能攻擊等限制，也讓玩家質疑遊戲是否削弱了自由度。

黑色幽默、彩蛋與世界細節

作者提到，遊戲仍保有 R 星擅長的黑色幽默，透過電視新聞與逮捕場景呈現對不同社群的戲謔，引起各種解讀。玩家也在地圖中發現 UFO、野人等彩蛋，以及情緒激動的路人和搶車受害者等生動 NPC。動物互動同樣豐富，玩家能與狗互動，甚至可能在搶走載有貓咪的車輛時遭到反擊，展現遊戲世界的細節與趣味。

商業成功與付費爭議

作者總結，儘管不同地區玩家關注的議題各異，許多人仍讚賞遊戲以精細畫面與系統塑造出栩栩如生的邁阿密，也肯定 R 星對細節的掌握。作品在商業上表現亮眼，但豪華版內容設有付費門檻，加上每月訂閱的 GTA+ 制度，也引起玩家反感。整體而言，《GTA 6》既展現了強大的製作實力，也因評價、內容設計與商業策略而爭議不斷。
